text: Task title shall be between 1 and 100 characters
Empty task title shall show error Title is required
User shall create a new task and see it in the list
User shall mark a task as completed and show strikethrough style
User shall delete a task and remove it from the list
When 50 active tasks exist creating another shall show error Task limit reached
Completing a non-existent task id shall show error Task not found
Deleting a completed task shall remove it from both active and completed views
